explication: gh-stack is a GitHub CLI extension for managing ordered stacks of branches and their pull requests. The typical workflow initializes a stack, adds branches, rebases and pushes the stack, then submits linked PRs to GitHub; users can also inspect, navigate, check out, or modify stacks. Local stack metadata tracks branch order and PR associations, while Git and GitHub operations are exposed through internal adapters. The graph follows README-documented behavior and sampled interfaces; several command implementations were not sampled, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
